an5.210:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa niddaṃ okkamato.
an5.210:1.3: dukkhaṃ supati, dukkhaṃ paṭibujjhati, pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati, devatā na rakkhanti, asuci muccati.
an5.210:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa niddaṃ okkamato.
an5.210:2.1: pañcime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā upaṭṭhitasatissa sampajānassa niddaṃ okkamato.
an5.210:2.3: sukhaṃ supati, sukhaṃ paṭibujjhati, na pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati, devatā rakkhanti, asuci na muccati.
an5.210:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā upaṭṭhitasatissa sampajānassa niddaṃ okkamatoti.
